reference_id.description: A 32-digit hex value used to identify the web service request. The value is unique to each web service request, is randomly-generated by Telesign, and is returned in the response message immediately following the web service request.

external_id.description: The customer-generated ID for this transaction that was provided in the request. If the `external_id` parameter was not included in the request, the value here is `null`.

status.description: An object containing details about the request status.

code.description:
Transaction status code. Successful transactions can be assigned one of the following values:
• 300 - successful transaction
• 301 - partially successful transaction

updated_on.description: An [RFC 3339](http://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc3339.txt) timestamp indicating when the transaction status was updated.

email_address_details.description: Contains cleansing and intelligence details about the submitted email address.

cleansed.description: Provides the normalized version of the email address along with the extracted username and domain components.

email_address.description: The cleansed email address after correcting common formatting issues.

is_valid.description: Indicates whether the cleansed email address is syntactically valid.

username.description: The local-part (username) extracted from the cleansed email address

domain.description: The domain portion extracted from the cleansed email address.

cleansing_details.description: Describes modifications applied during cleansing and includes indicators such as gibberish probability and tagging.

is_modified.description: Indicates whether the submitted email address was modified during cleansing.

gibberish_probability.description: A probability score indicating how likely the email username appears algorithmically generated or nonsensical.

tag.description: A tag extracted from the email address, such as a plustag, if applicable.

domain_details.description: Provides structured information about the domain associated with the email address.

registered_domain.description: The registered/base domain associated with the email address.

tld.description: The toplevel domain extracted from the email address.

tld_type.description: The classification of the toplevel domain, such as general or countrycode.

is_disposable.description: Indicates whether the email domain is known to be disposable.

intelligence_details.description: Contains properties related to the risk recommendation and supporting insights.

email_address.description: The email address value exactly as provided in the request.

is_valid.description: Indicates whether the original email address is syntactically valid.

Original.description: Contains the submitted email address exactly as provided and its initial validity evaluation.

Risk.title: Risk
Risk.description: Contains properties related to the risk recommendation for the specified email address.

recommendation.description: The action that Telesign recommends that you take based on the risk recommendation.

score.description: A measure of transaction risk, ranging from zero to 1000, with a higher value indicating a higher risk.

RiskInsights.title: RiskInsights
RiskInsights.description: Contains reason code properties with additional info related to the risk recommendation.

category.description: Reason codes related to the risk category.

phone_number.description: Provides activity‑based and static reason codes related to the phone number linked to the email address.

activity.description: Reason codes related to activity associated with the phone number linked to this email address.

static.description: Reason codes related to static attributes of the phone number linked to this email address.

ip_address.description: Contains activity‑based and static reason codes associated with the IP address linked to the email address.

activity.description: Reason codes related to activity associated with the IP address linked to this email address.

static.description: Reason codes related to static attributes of the IP address linked to this email address.

email_address.description: Provides activity, static, and domain‑related reason codes associated directly with the email address itself.

activity.description: Reason codes related to activity associated with the email address.

static.description: Reason codes related to static attributes of the email address.

domain.description: Reason codes related to domain based attributes of the email address.
